P033 freezes one clean query from each of 54 eligible reserved reference components before P030/P032 results; 53 are Composition and 1 is Context Fit.
The 102 clean non-Composition reserved rows occupy only two reference components, so they are a descriptive sensitivity pool and cannot support independent category generalization.

RMCD (WACV 2026) already performs relevance-weighted signed multi-context logit aggregation; MultiSHAP already attributes generic multimodal interactions. Multi-sham averaging or ordinary interaction contrasts are not novel by themselves.
ARS-MMT (CMES 2026) already contrasts zeroed and batch-shuffled visual features to separate modality presence from image-specific content; reference shuffling is a control, not standalone novelty.
P030 completed with 3840 unique finite scores. Labelled dual improved AP@10 over labelled single by 0.662 pp, but the 95% component interval crossed zero; dual was 0.117 pp below sham.
P032 failed its locked gate: RCR reduced AP@10 by 0.414 pp and positive-vs-explicit-negative macro AUC was 0.4975. P033 held-out execution is cancelled without image fetching or scoring.

P031 attempt 1 completed all 1104 base3b embeddings, then failed before any Coral embedding because a redundant nested text_config was incompatible with transformers 4.51; a same-weight config adapter passed CPU preflight.
P034 fixed alpha=1 failed: RNCR changed AP@10 by -0.701 pp for Qwen7B and -0.512 pp for Coral; base3b changed by only +0.046 pp.
The missing-reference source-lift macro AUC was 0.225 for Qwen7B versus 0.553 for Coral, so direct subtraction is not a model-robust source-specific signal.

P035 completed with 1920 unique finite source scores. Fixed probabilistic AND reduced AP@10 by 1.043 pp (95% component CI [-2.301, -0.007]) and macro positive-vs-explicit-negative AUC from 0.808 to 0.533; only explicit-negative precision@10 improved, so 2/3 locked gates failed and held-out execution is forbidden.
Direct 2026 prior art already uses LLM-parsed absolute/relative constraints and Qwen2.5-VL verification to rerank single-reference fashion CIR; explicit constraint verification alone is occupied.

Conformal candidate sets and uncertainty calibration already exist in single-reference CIR, while Any2Any calibrates heterogeneous multimodal retrieval scores; P036 therefore limits its candidate delta to source-bound multi-reference vetoing with joint-order preservation and explicit-negative evaluation.

Expanding all clean reserved-component rows yields 518 queries, 262 positive and 518 explicit-negative top20 candidate instances; a metadata-only staged split balances 16 positive-bearing components across development and confirmation.

SoFT (arXiv:2512.20781) directly establishes training-free CIR reranking with MLLM-extracted prescriptive/proscriptive constraints and CLIP reward/penalty score modulation; positive/negative constraint reranking is therefore not a P036 novelty claim.

UniCVR (arXiv:2604.20318) establishes adaptive MLLM scoring of top candidates and dual-level reranking across composed visual retrieval; generic candidate-subset MLLM reranking is therefore not a P036 novelty claim.
RCIR (AAAI 2025) already provides coverage-risk-controlled adaptive sets for image retrieval; image-retrieval risk control is occupied prior art.

Two-stage Risk Control for Ranked Retrieval (IJCAI 2025) already controls separate retrieval and ranking risks with LTT/CRC and data splitting; staged risk-controlled reranking is occupied cross-domain prior art.

SoFT sweeps a continuous interpolation weight and reports that penalty-only reranking can sharply degrade results; its inspected method does not use a calibrated hard veto, but this alone does not make P036 novel.
SoFA (CVPR 2025) and DOCD (CVPR Findings 2026) occupy generic multi-image/modality order-bias diagnosis and dual-order correction; order averaging alone is not novel.
TAPR (arXiv:2608.25305v2) already factorizes single-reference CIR into Target/Add/Preserve/Remove and applies factor-specific local matching; constraint factorization alone is not novel.
ReBind (arXiv:2607.14681) validates explicit reference tokens at semantic positions for multi-reference video editing; this is the main adjacent-domain transfer primitive for P038.
MultiBind (arXiv:2603.21937) separates self-degradation from cross-subject confusion in generation; P038 adapts that separation to equivalence gap versus wrong-binding contrast in retrieval.
Janossy Pooling, Set Transformer, and Multi-Set Transformer establish permutation/set operators; P038 must distinguish joint role-reference relabeling from unconditional image exchangeability.
P041视觉数据门槛失败：100组中仅37组同时通过，正例源/目标检查为63%/60%，交换负对照为97%/91%；停止元数据替代路线且未启动训练，不能据此否定条件依赖假设。
P049 exactly reproduced the P048 frozen baseline after the implementation audit caught and corrected a system-prompt mismatch: mAP@10 0.7983817 and R@10 0.9609375.

P049 used 144/128/64 train/validation/confirmation bundles and 1,344 within-pilot-disjoint products; validation and confirmation were identical to P048, and training products had zero held-out overlap.

P049 final static and runtime audits were faithful: 36/36 LoRA language layers, the visual merger, scalar head, original/swap positive and negative branches, and paraphrase branches all received gradients; the frozen base had no optimizer path.

The ordinary verifier was a strong control at mAP@10 0.85677 and paraphrase mAP@10 0.80614. Positive-only counterfactual training raised main mAP to 0.87943 but collapsed paraphrase mAP to 0.68533, exposing a surface-form shortcut.
The DoD arm achieved mAP@10 0.84979, paraphrase mAP@10 0.83953, binding accuracy 0.94531, DoD pair accuracy 0.90625, and hard-negative violation 0.07031.

Paired bootstrap supported DoD over frozen on mAP (+0.05141, 95% CI [0.01424, 0.09094]), paraphrase mAP (+0.10760, [0.06437, 0.15396]), DoD margin over ordinary (+0.22271, [0.17048, 0.27544]), and hard-negative violation reduction (-0.0625, [-0.11719, -0.015625]).
The primary innovation gate failed because DoD did not beat the ordinary verifier on mAP (-0.00698, 95% CI [-0.03639, 0.01942]); full-scale execution is not authorized.

Failure localization showed DoD raw-score mAP 0.85359 versus delta-score mAP 0.84979, while paraphrase moved in the opposite direction (0.82930 raw to 0.83953 delta). Universal delta use is the current bottleneck; the main evidence is concentrated in color roles and cannot support general-role claims.

The 2026-09-27 novelty re-audit found that TAPR/MulVec (arXiv:2608.25305v2) already factorizes CIR requests into Target/Add/Preserve/Remove and performs factor-specific candidate evidence matching; generic role or factor decomposition is occupied.

WISER (CVPR 2026) already uses verifier confidence for adaptive fusion and conditional refinement, while AutoConcept (arXiv:2609.01456, PRICAI 2026) already performs query-specific reliability gating and calibrated interpolation between a fixed retriever and concept evidence; selective score fusion is not a standalone P050 novelty.

EviRank (arXiv:2608.20886) already converts composed queries into typed required/forbidden/ignorable evidence and performs evidence-conditioned verification; generic structured verifier or evidence checklist claims are occupied.

The public search did not find a direct work that jointly studies multi-reference source-role binding, shared-candidate single-role swap difference-in-differences, and official PinPoint multi-image evaluation. This is a provisional novelty delta, not a first claim, and must be confirmed by a deeper full-paper search before submission.

Current re-audit verdict: the problem has high value and the route has medium-high development potential, but current conference readiness is low. P050 as a generic selective gate should not proceed unchanged; the next pilot must first validate the phenomenon with human-auditable role annotations and official multi-image metrics.

PinPoint explicitly reports that multi-image queries drop 48-72%; the strongest reported multi-image mAP@10 is 0.074 for GPT-5 text premerge plus reranking, while reranking does not improve multi-image results. The paper calls for better image-composition architectures and linguistically diverse training.

STiTch/SCOT/DIPNEC occupy generic optimal-transport alignment for CIR, while TAPR occupies atomic role factorization plus full-gallery local evidence matching. OT, local tokens, and generic role decomposition are not sufficient novelty.

MOSAIC (ICLR 2026) and ReBind show that explicit multi-reference correspondence/attribution can prevent reference interference in generation/editing. A direct copy is invalid for retrieval because the target is unknown and gallery representations must be indexable; the transferable supervision is source-to-target correspondence, not the generation architecture.

A targeted public search found no direct CIR method that constructs a candidate-conditioned source-role affinity matrix and normalizes the intended assignment against all counterfactual source-role permutations. This is a provisional novelty delta and not a first claim.
CVPR 2027 paper registration and submission deadlines are 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-16 AOE, respectively; the remaining schedule requires a kill-gated method pilot before full training.

evaluation_policy.novelty_transfer: A method proven in another field can still be a valid contribution if this is its first use in the target task, the transfer requires task-specific technical adaptation, and experiments isolate the adaptation from a direct copy.

pilot_before_full.rule: Every proposed full-scale experiment must first run a bounded, preregistered pilot.
pilot_must_define: frozen mechanism and task-level success gates
integrity checks and explicit stop rule
pilot_before_full.full_scale_authorization: Prepare or run full scale only when every frozen pilot gate passes and the estimated evidence gain justifies the compute.
pilot_before_full.failed_pilot_action: Stop the implementation or redesign a materially different mechanism; do not enlarge the same failed method.

pretrial_evidence_review.trigger: Before designing or launching every new experimental idea
must_state: Observed prior results and their scope; separate observations from causal hypotheses
Which demonstrated failure the proposed mechanism could address, and which failures it cannot address
Theoretical argument, explicit assumptions, relevant published support, and nearest standard baseline
Cheapest falsifiers with fixed data/compute budget, mechanism and task metrics, and pass/fail/inconclusive rules
controls: Validate swapped-query relevance labels; a swapped positive is not automatically negative
Separate semantic-preserving source-role block permutation from semantic-changing role rebinding
Measure first-stage labelled-positive coverage and fixed-candidate oracle before attributing low retrieval AP to reranking
Compare to same-model, same-data, matched-trainable-parameter ordinary relevance training and generic hard negatives
Use reference/image/template-separated validation; repeated observed cases provide exploratory evidence only
Bind full-scale progression to task ranking, binding discrimination, and non-degradation evidence; proxy gains alone cannot pass
A noisy interval crossing the preregistered gate is inconclusive and does not authorize full scale; it is not proof that the topic is false
pretrial_evidence_review.current_learned_binding_status: P046 passed data and implementation audits, but its single-seed mechanism pilot failed the all-required gate: role margin improved while pair accuracy did not beat generic augmentation. No full-scale run is authorized.

literature_priority.policy: Prioritize recent primary papers and official implementations addressing similar mechanisms, including cross-domain work; earlier foundational sources remain eligible. Verify venue/status and novelty; recent year alone is not evidence of innovation.
literature_priority.cross_domain_transfer: Identify mechanism correspondence, assumptions, task-specific adaptation, and a direct-transfer comparison. First-in-field claims require explicit literature verification.

postimplementation_audit.trigger: Automatically after each new method implementation or substantive mechanism/training/computation change, before the efficacy pilot; bounded debugging is separate.
checks: Faithfulness to the specified mechanism and assumptions
Unintended conservative degradation that prevents the mechanism from acting or learning
Incomplete prototype substituted for the full method
Implementation errors in data/roles/labels, formulas/losses/masks, gradients/optimizer, checkpoint loading and metrics
postimplementation_audit.evidence: Map design to executable code and actual configuration; add only necessary mechanism-specific runtime evidence. Code running, decreasing loss or improved metrics alone do not establish correctness.
postimplementation_audit.pilot_rule: Reduce data and compute while retaining all mechanisms and training freedoms required to test the hypothesis. Insufficient optimization is inconclusive, not falsification.
postimplementation_audit.decision: Repair unintended degradation, incompleteness or errors before a valid pilot. Preserve invalid runs and document causes; freeze revised versions before rerunning. Do not relax result gates after observation.

P017.interpretation: 同SDPA协议下patch读出方图60/76、较高分辨率52/76，原输出均39。固定总attention选层后patch为59/48，收益不全由换层造成。新分辨率下相对AGD的区间仍跨0，不作SOTA。
P017.limits: 所有输入实际仍是同尺寸方图，未测试不同宽高比/不同图像token数；Mantis反复使用，仅探索证据。

P018.interpretation: P017 patch校准重采样的正确数2.5/50/97.5分位：方图57/60/62，较高分辨率47/50/52。只是固定评测集的校准敏感性。所有图像token数相同，密度归一化对照退化为常数，不能证明不等长度鲁棒性。

P019.interpretation: eager/SDPA均精确重放各自旧分数（误差0），eager关闭输出attention误差0；换成eager视觉特征后SDPA仍有0.52至0.89的中心化候选差异，语言后端差异不能忽略。视觉特征相对L2差约0.038至0.061，也可改变低间隔答案；不应跨后端比较微小涨点。

P020.interpretation: SigLIP2只答对7/19原题；同题重复排列不是独立新样本。直接forward与特征重建最大误差1.14e-5。

P021.interpretation: 默认重复惩罚压低提示中出现过的1和4；修正BF16反推舍入后，7B高分辨率原始logits为47/76、patch为52/76，差值区间[-2.38,19.44]百分点跨0。LAD展示公式与公开代码在条件统计、层池化和偏置混合上不同；公式级对照不等于完整论文复现。

P022.interpretation: 六个设置18个真实GPU forward，processed分数精确重放；逆重复惩罚后回到BF16网格能精确恢复raw logits，未经舍入有两处并列答案被错误打破。

P024.interpretation: 同7B、同原生分辨率下，逐图描述条件似然52/76与patch52/76持平；差值簇区间[-21.875,17.045]个百分点。旧19题未证明超越简单同模型逐图基线。两种逐图评分无top ties。

P026_annotation_audit.interpretation: 只按作者明确正标签切片，缺失、空白或无某代码不等于现象阴性；context也混合程度比较与跨帧指代，不能当不可逐图求解的真值。

P023_data_integrity.interpretation: 视频文件名是非连续源帧号，gold是数值排序后的0-9索引，已与官方代码核对。仅替换一个与验证图像重叠的同目标/同类别校准题，验证256题与人工标签切片完全不变，发生于任何P023推理前。

P023.interpretation: 原始logits100/256，patch92，密度91，SigLIP2为84。patch相对原始-3.125个百分点，簇95CI[-8.203,1.953]；旧Mantis小样本收益没有在独立ImageCoDe复现。停止将patch-only读出作为候选新方法，不把普通all-span的102/103题当新贡献。
P023.decision: 停止patch-only分数调参和扩展；P025/P027用于定位强基线下仍存在的问题，不作为继续追逐旧收益的理由。

P026.interpretation: 正标签49题仍难；差值区间宽，不能据此宣布联合上下文有效。空白不是阴性。

P028.decision: 该固定最小分辨率提升无整体收益，停止参数扫描。

P029.conclusion: 固定逐条分数中，四个标注目标均被错图逐坐标支配；任何坐标单调不减聚合不能严格将目标排在该错图之上。仅限该后验小样本，不是新定理或总体结论。

PinPoint_reference_audit.scope: 只证明当前公开代码的信息通路遗漏，尚未验证论文表格使用的历史实现或性能影响。

P030_metadata.primary_labels: deduplicated positive/negative sets; selected rows have no positive-negative overlap

P030.interpretation: Dual input has a small descriptive gain over labelled single, but its interval crosses zero and it is slightly worse than the fixed sham. The 48-query cohort is Composition only.

P032.decision: Kill P032/P033 negative-control calibration branch; do not fetch or score held-out P033 data.

P031.interpretation: Coral improves over its base model descriptively, but neither model shows stable second-reference use on this pilot; Coral dual is no better than single and trails sham/text-only.

P034.decision: Reject fixed alpha=1 direct score subtraction. This does not reject cross-domain transfer; the transfer needs source-bound predicate construction rather than a raw counterfactual difference.

P035.decision: Reject this source-isolated predicate judging plus fixed probabilistic AND implementation; do not access P033 or any reserved component. This does not reject cross-domain transfer in general.

P038.decision: Stop full-scale SIRC. Keep it as diagnostic evidence that semantic interleaving reduces relabeling sensitivity but does not improve ranking on this pilot.

P039.decision: Stop SBB expansion. No narrow bridge window met the required soft-plus-0.05 binding gain; the all-layer control was highest and is ineligible.

P041_visual_data_gate.conclusion: The metadata-substitution construction is visually unreliable. Negative controls largely work, so lowering the gate is not justified. The conditional-dependence hypothesis was not trained or tested.

implementation_audit.classification: intended gate implemented faithfully; failure diagnostics were initially insufficient
implementation_audit.issue: per-bundle pixel metrics were written only on success
implementation_audit.fix: persist per-bundle metrics before the gate on both pass and failure

P042_pixel_data_gate.conclusion: P042 is stopped. Full-image MAE confounded masked manipulation strength with background area, and the frozen pool did not yield 100 eligible bundles. No visual judge or training was run.

P043_visual_data_gate.conclusion: Official MERIT positives are not usable as strict role-conditioned visual-equivalence groups under the frozen judge. Strong negative controls argue against lowering the gate. No training was run.

P044_reference_subset_screen.decision: P044 remains failed; no training. Manual review of the eight other-identity failures suggests judge false negatives, motivating a separately frozen independent-judge pilot rather than changing P044.

P045_independent_judge_screen.decision: Stop automatic-judge role routing. Judge-dependent pseudo labels are not solid enough for training or claims.

P046.decision: Do not scale. The margin signal is encouraging, but the role arm did not improve held-out pair accuracy over generic augmentation.

diagnosis.scope: 126/128 validation examples use color as the active role; general-role claims are unsupported.

P049.decision: Do not scale. Preserve the ordinary verifier utility anchor and test independently calibrated selective role-effect correction on broader roles.

remaining: visual relative quality gate and manual inspection
matched full multi-arm driver and complete gallery metric integration
matched multi-arm training and full-gallery evaluation
legacy_debug_runtime_audit.runtime_label_scope: P049 images reused only to test computational paths; assignment/DoD labels here are not new verified research evidence

orbits_prepare_summary.template_policy: new metadata-derived queries; not official MERIT queries or official benchmark scores

embedding_model_integrity_audit.scope: main embedding encoder weights, tokenizer/processor configs and official embedding source; not model efficacy

comprehensive_audit.audit_scope: P051 TraceBind model, objective, encoder, checkpoint, construction/extraction/isolation/correspondence/visual-screening pipeline; historical methods are evidence, not reimplemented here
fixed_issues: valid-assignment likelihood handles multiple positives and masks unknown permutations
DoD uses the exact same per-permutation positive-minus-negative ordering as construction audit

blocking_findings.issue: Matched multi-arm training driver and official full-gallery metric integration are missing
blocking_findings.effect: A two-step runtime audit cannot certify faithful complete training or SOTA.

blocking_findings.issue: Final visually verified 5000/1000/400 role-balanced orbit dataset is not certified
blocking_findings.effect: Metadata-derived candidates and cross-domain pseudo correspondences cannot bypass the visual gate.

blocking_findings.issue: Synthetic coarse-attribute queries can have unlabelled semantic positives
blocking_findings.effect: Single-product-ID mAP over their full gallery can count correct targets as negatives; requires multi-positive relevance or separate official query evaluation.

blocking_findings.issue: One distinct role per source and restricted same-attribute grammar
blocking_findings.effect: Cannot claim unrestricted PinPoint query support; official instruction parser and coverage audit remain necessary.

blocking_findings.issue: The permutation-augmentation control currently has equivalent query views, not genuine wrong-binding augmentation
blocking_findings.effect: It is not yet the promised strong matched corruption-augmentation baseline.

blocking_findings.issue: Active-role relative validation does not verify all roles or full-energy DoD assumptions
blocking_findings.effect: Other-role error cancellation remains a weak metadata assumption; must retain that uncertainty in claims and supervision.

blocking_findings.issue: Every non-identity bijective permutation changes at least two source-role bindings
blocking_findings.effect: Permutation DoD is not a controlled single-role intervention. Checking only the active cue cannot certify the complete permutation ordering; isolate the intervention or verify the other changed roles before making that claim.

blocking_findings.issue: Exact pixel isolation does not exclude all near-duplicate product photos
blocking_findings.effect: Near-duplicate review still required before an independent generalization claim.

theory_limits: R2 assignment posterior equals log-sigmoid of identity-minus-swap energy; the formula alone is not innovation.
Frozen anchors constrain geometry locally; they do not prove global recall is preserved.
Cross-domain correspondence agreement is pseudo supervision, not retrieval role ground truth.

P051.decision: 核心计算路径正确，完整方法尚未就绪；原始数据已补齐，正式 pilot 标注未达标。停止该版本自动标注扩量和效果训练，不把质量核验失败解释为 TraceBind 效果失败。

novelty_status: A generic frozen-retriever plus multimodal verifier is occupied prior art and is a strong P049 control (mAP@10 0.8568). P049 establishes a narrower mechanism signal: candidate-level role interventions with difference-in-differences significantly improve role margin, paraphrase retrieval, and hard-negative violations over the frozen baseline, but do not beat the ordinary verifier on primary mAP. Novelty is therefore not established. A defensible next claim would require independently calibrated selective use of role effects and broader-role evidence, rather than universal delta reranking or generic verifier training.

last_progress_audit.this_turn: SSH 已恢复，TraceBind 核心实现和运行审计完成；数据规模门槛未通过
remaining: visual relative screening and stratified inspection
matched multi-arm training driver and gallery metrics

P032_quick.strongest_point: Binary log-odds gives an exact, parameter-free transfer of contrastive decoding to reference-conditioned relevance scoring, with a held-out-group path.
top_rejection_risks: The score formula is inherited directly from VCD; applying it to PinPoint alone is not a sufficient novelty delta.
A single mismatched reference changes both semantics and input distribution, so dual-minus-sham is not an identifiable causal effect.
A 48-query reranking pilot cannot establish generality or SOTA, and candidate/reference dependencies weaken naive intervals.
score_change_conditions: The locked P032 primary score must improve over dual input and its lift must discriminate positives from explicit negatives.
The same fixed construction must survive preregistered untouched components and at least one separately trained retriever/reranker.
A multi-negative or structured negative-control estimator must be derived and shown to isolate source-specific evidence better than random noise, missing-image, and generic VCD controls.
P032_quick.recommendation: revise; use P032 as a kill gate, not as a claimed method.

P033_quick.strongest_point: A result-independent held-out component split with balanced bilateral reference substitutions can test source-bound evidence rather than a single arbitrary sham.
top_rejection_risks: RMCD already covers signed multi-context logit aggregation and MultiSHAP covers generic interaction attribution.
The held-out cohort is almost entirely Composition, while non-Composition rows provide only two independent reference components.
P033 remains a selected top-20 reranking diagnostic and is not a full-corpus SOTA evaluation.
P033_quick.decision_rule: Do not execute unless all locked P032 directional gates pass; after execution, the primary replication interval must exclude zero and the mechanism intervals must pass before secondary scores are interpreted.
P033_quick.recommendation: keep only as a gated confirmation/diagnostic protocol; novelty is not established

P039_quick.strongest_point: The method preserves the useful joint stream while adding a narrow source-private high-dimensional path, directly combining the two strongest failure lessons from P014 and P035.
top_rejection_risks: Bridge tokens, attention masking, and activation intervention are individually prior art; only the task-specific combination and evidence can support novelty.
P039 reuses ten observed development queries and cannot support an effectiveness claim.
A layer-window gain could be prompt-specific or model-specific unless it survives a frozen component-disjoint P040 pilot and later independent models.
score_change_conditions: A narrow layer window must pass all frozen P039 binding, score-preservation, and order-equivalence gates while beating the all-layer control.
The selected window must then pass a separately frozen component-disjoint P040 pilot without retuning.
A later paper claim requires full-corpus retrieval, uncertainty by reference component, and at least one independently trained model family.
P039_quick.recommendation: Run P039 only as a kill-gated mechanism screen; do not call the idea novel or effective unless later prospective evidence survives.

CVPR2027_SOTA_route_20260927.verdict: P050 is too incremental as a main method; proceed only with a structured full-gallery source-role binding retriever after user confirmation.
CVPR2027_SOTA_route_20260927.strongest_point: It turns the demonstrated shared-candidate role-swap signal into an indexable structured assignment likelihood that can affect full-gallery retrieval, rather than another Top-K gate.
top_rejection_risks: Reviewers may view it as TAPR multi-vector matching plus permutation negatives unless the source-role assignment likelihood and retrieval-specific invariance are isolated by direct controls.
MERIT role metadata is noisy and earlier pilots were color-dominated; correspondence pretraining and balanced multi-role counterfactual groups must pass data audits.
A multi-vector full-gallery scorer can be too slow or gain only on identity-style data; latency, memory, and cross-domain attribute transfer must be measured.
The provisional novelty search may miss contemporaneous work, so first-use language remains forbidden.

candidate_proposals.title: 指令条件选择性依赖学习：直接训练多参考全图库检索器
candidate_proposals.hypothesis: 同一来源属性变化，在指令使用该属性时应改变目标，在指令不使用该属性时应保持检索语义；显式监督这种条件响应可能改善真实多参考检索。既有失败尚未证明此机制是主要瓶颈。
old_evidence: P014全来源隔离曾损害该实现的检索，保留多图联合上下文。
P035来源谓词标量AND损害排序，避免将来源证据预先压成独立分数。
P037-P039代理绑定/顺序变化未提供稳定排序收益；改为可学习检索并同时要求真实检索收益。
P030已观察48个开发查询中仅12个top20含已标注正例；oracle_top20 mAP@10=0.0675595238。该结果只适用于该子集，要求区分全图库召回和重排。

mechanism.backbone: 候选Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B；它在本项目尚未实测，不能声称优于现有基线。
mechanism.query: 原生多图及带来源指代的指令联合编码；保留图间推理。
mechanism.retrieval: 训练查询/候选共享编码器的检索空间，在完整图库召回；需要时各臂采用相同固定reranker。
mechanism.training_scope: 拟采用覆盖语言模型所有层attention/MLP的高秩LoRA和可训练视觉merger，查询与候选分支均保留梯度；先做80GB显存/吞吐profiling再冻结具体配置。不是只训练分数头或若干role token。不得因显存而悄悄冻结必要通路。
mechanism.data: 优先从MERIT训练产品属性及真实变体构造经过语义核验的有效改变/无关改变/语义等价重排组。来源组件隔离、多正例标注、排除参考目标重复和答案文本泄漏。MERIT官方字段支持此候选构造，但有效组数量与标签质量未核验。
mechanism.objective: 多正例检索损失 + 无关改变/语义等价变换下的检索分布一致性 + 经核验的有效改变下正确候选对的双向排序约束。损失权重/温度须在任何效能pilot前冻结。
mechanism.theory: 若指令定义目标语义G_t，则有效来源变换u对应目标语义变换u_t：G_t(uR)=u_t(G_t(R))；无关变化时u_t为恒等。该任务一致性条件不构成新定理，也不保证因果可识别或真实检索泛化。
mechanism.novelty_boundary: 来源绑定、反事实增强、不变性、对比学习均已有先例。待验证增量是同一属性变换在不同来源角色指令下产生不同效应的成组监督及其全图库迁移；相同样本/预算普通微调必须作为核心反证。普通相关性训练在完整监督下也可能达到相同理想解。

pilot_draft.stage0: 先对齐PinPoint论文与当前官方仓库的数据/脚本/切分/指标，检查独立开发组件清单；只做合法开发诊断，确认/held-out不访问。先测8B未微调基线及候选覆盖，审计实际错误是否包含足够来源选择性依赖问题。
pilot_draft.data_gate: 拟抽检100组有效/无关干预对，至少95%按预定标准可确认有效；不确定标签排除，组内语义要求与数据来源必须可追溯。不能制造可靠组则停止此数据路线。
pilot_draft.implementation_gate: 正式效能pilot前自动审计：完整实现/保守退化/最小原型/错误/证据不足。检查两图真实进入、角色及candidate标签、梯度与参数更新、有效/无关分支、损失方向、评估口径和训练期间缓存一致性。错误先修复，不能把bug结果解释为方法失败。
pilot_draft.external_pilot: 拟512训练干预组、256来源组件独立验证组；3个训练臂为同数据普通检索、同数据加通用不变性、提出的条件响应学习；同8B初始化/输入/样本/优化器/有效batch/最大步数/训练参数范围。每臂3 seeds，每run最多200步或2 GPU小时先到即止，训练总上限18 GPU小时，不含另行固定的全图库编码评测预算。不得事后因结果不好扩步或搜索。
pilot_draft.proposed_go_gates: 预先冻结组级完整判别指标；相对最强匹配对照组准确率至少+5个百分点，真实全图库mAP@10至少+0.005，两者按来源组件配对95% CI下界>0；无关变化的错误翻转率不恶化。文本单独/遮图/错误来源对照验证使用视觉来源。阈值为拟议研究决策门槛，不是理论保证。
pilot_draft.real_transfer_gate: 外部机制门槛通过后，仅在此前未用于选法的合法独立开发组件做PinPoint真实全图库pilot；同时报告Recall@20/100、oracle和最终mAP，固定reranker以区分召回收益与排序收益。需在PinPoint多图mAP@10较最强匹配对照至少+0.005且配对95% CI下界>0；整体或单图mAP非劣容忍为0.005且CI须支持。组件不足或统计不充分记不确定，不全量。
pilot_draft.stopped_cases: 标签不能成立、普通微调同样有效且无条件响应增益、只在合成组有效、遮图后增益仍保留、真实召回/排序不改善，则停止或修正对应假设。优化尚不充分记不确定，不归为机制被证伪，也不直接扩大。
pilot_draft.prereg_required: 启动前冻结实际样本ID及组件划分、配置、训练自由度、种子、最大步数/总GPU小时、评测预算、CI聚类方式和全部门槛。当前数量和预算是供审阅的草案。

candidate_proposals.sotatarget: PinPoint多图mAP@10及全体mAP@10/NegRecall@10，首先匹配数据版本和监督口径。论文v1多图0.074仅历史参考；当前官方README与论文部分全体数值不同，尚未解释差异。必须超过同口径复现的近期强方法及8B普通微调，而非只跨旧数值。
candidate_proposals.gpu: physical GPU1 UUID GPU-277ce254-c418-8feb-d0eb-e3929d6a6f9f; live occupancy check before launch; no silent fallback

stage0_result.conclusion: The metadata-substitution construction is visually unreliable. Negative controls largely work, so lowering the gate is not justified. The conditional-dependence hypothesis was not trained or tested.

candidate_proposals.title: 角色条件变换等变性：同一颜色干预在多参考检索中的等变—不变二分
predecessor_evidence: P041直接元数据替代的100组视觉契约仅37组完整通过，因此该数据路线已停止且没有训练。
P014反对切断多图联合上下文；P035反对把来源约束过早压成固定标量；P038/P039说明表示稳定或内部状态变化不能替代检索收益。
MERIT官方训练查询中有168,942条双参考单正例包含且仅包含一个color角色；固定96个shard及视觉非颜色白名单内、排除P041审计产品后有2,075条候选。

mechanism.data: 使用官方MERIT双参考正例；当一个来源负责color、另一个来源负责可见非颜色属性时，对饱和像素执行固定HSV色相旋转。颜色角色与正目标同步变换形成等变对；非颜色角色单独变换而目标保持形成不变对。
mechanism.theory: 若检索语义由指令选择的角色属性决定，则颜色变换H应满足G(Hr_color,r_other)=H G(r_color,r_other)，而G(r_color,Hr_other)=G(r_color,r_other)。这只是任务一致性约束，不保证真实商品图库泛化。
mechanism.training_if_gated: 仍使用Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B共享查询/候选空间；与同数据普通检索、通用不变性做同预算对照。正式实现必须保留双图联合编码、候选梯度、高秩全层LoRA和视觉merger更新，并先自动审计。

candidate_proposals.theory: Let z_r indicate whether reference role r has a valid relation to the labeled target. A multi-reference query has a subset state z in {0,1}^R; valid subsets may provide partial likelihood terms while invalid roles must not supervise the joint positive. candidate_proposals.title: Self-normalized role-corruption learning with a shared target
evidence_chain: P037 showed the frozen model does not reliably discriminate wrong bindings, so a training signal is needed rather than another inference correction.
P041 source-swapped negative controls passed 97% and P043 color-cross negatives passed 98%, supporting role corruption as a reliable negative operation.
P041/P043 absolute positive contracts failed, and P044/P045 role labels were judge-dependent, so the next objective must not require absolute role-validity pseudo labels.
candidate_proposals.mechanism: For each official multi-reference query-target pair, keep the target fixed and compare the original joint query with a query where exactly one instructed reference role is corrupted. Optimize a paired margin on the score difference while preserving the full joint stream. Target quality and instance difficulty are shared within the pair rather than converted into an absolute clean/noisy label.
candidate_proposals.theory: If target-label quality and target difficulty contribute an additive pair-shared nuisance term, subtracting corrupted-query score from original-query score cancels that term. This is a limited invariance argument, not a causal-identification theorem; interaction-dependent label noise may remain.
candidate_proposals.novelty_boundary: Counterfactual negatives, robust contrastive learning, MPCIR noise routing, and multi-reference binding are prior art. The candidate increment is role-indexed within-query corruption with a shared target as self-normalized weak supervision for multi-image CIR, evaluated against same-data ordinary fine-tuning and generic corruption controls. A first-use claim is unverified.
required_falsification_before_training: Freeze a product-disjoint corruption-confirmation set and donor policy before scoring.
Require role corruption to break the intended relation under calibrated controls without requiring the original pair to pass an absolute visual contract.
Audit that only the selected reference changes, target and other reference hashes stay identical, role tokens remain aligned, and no candidate labels leak.

Pre-register a small training pilot with ordinary fine-tuning, generic image augmentation, and role-corruption arms under identical data, trainable parameters, steps, seeds, and full-gallery evaluation.

candidate_proposals.mechanism: A frozen base retriever supplies Top-10 candidates. An 8B candidate-aware cross-encoder compares each candidate under the original query, a single-role text swap, and a paraphrase. The proposed arm learns positive counterfactual ordering, positive-versus-negative difference-in-differences, and paraphrase effect consistency.

candidate_proposals.transfer_insight: The ordinary verifier acts as a utility model, while the DoD objective acts as an invariance/robustness regularizer. candidate_proposals.title: Candidate-conditioned permutation-normalized source-role binding for multi-reference composed image retrieval

core_model.query: Encode interleaved reference-role pairs and form every source-under-role probe u_ij.
core_model.gallery: Precompute a global vector and a compact bank of candidate evidence slots.
core_model.affinity: A_ij(x)=SmoothMax_k <u_ij,v_k(x)> gives an R-by-R source-role affinity matrix for candidate x.
core_model.structured_binding: E_pi(x)=mean_j A_{pi(j),j}(x), normalized over feasible bijective permutations; R2 is exactly log-sigmoid of identity-minus-swap energy.
core_model.retrieval_score: Combine a preserved global relevance score with correct-role support and bounded structured binding likelihood; jointly permuting source-role blocks is invariant, while independently rebinding roles changes the score.

training: Ordinary multi-positive retrieval loss for utility.
